componentProbe.covers: Container writes, sandbox denial, self IPC/code identity, system child only; not full feature acceptance.

cliTransportProbe.covers: Fixture-only signed terminal CLI to sandbox broker: mutual identity, shell/Node/npm, logs, masking, key files, signals, command/folder grants and revocation. Full runtime gates remain pending.

fileAccessProbe.covers: Fixture-only, three launches of the development-signed sandbox build with harness-issued sandbox extensions in place of the Open panel: selected file, parent grant, atomic rewrite keeping permissions, restore after relaunch, removal across relaunch, unselected sibling denied. NSOpenPanel, volume disconnect and moved references remain manual; the gate stays pending.

cliAdversarialProbe.covers: The transport suite plus unsigned forged context and grant fields, claimed folder and origin, single-use grant replay and a vanishing caller. Real PID reuse, MCP and SSH remain pending; the gate stays pending.
